meta.title: Satzbau — German for people who live here now
meta.description: Satzbau is a small German school in Saalbrück: courses from A1 to C1 in the mornings, evenings or online, classes of at most ten.
meta.noscript: You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.

site.tagline: German for people who live here now.

home.title: German for people who <mark>live here now</mark>.
home.lead: Small classes from A1 to C1, in the mornings, evenings or online, with teachers who moved countries themselves and know which words you need first.
home.whyTitle: A school, not a call centre
home.quizText: Ten questions, no sign-up, a level and the right courses at the end.

courses.description: German courses from A1 to C1: intensive, evening, online and exam preparation.
courses.title: Courses
courses.lead: Every course has ten places at most. Prices are for the whole course, books included.
courses.empty: No course like that is planned right now. Write to us — if three people ask, we start one.

course.online: Online — you get the link a week before
course.priceNote: for the whole course, books included
course.notSure: Not sure it’s your level? <quiz>Take the quiz</quiz>.
course.subject: Place in {{title}} ({{start}})

placement.description: A ten-question German placement quiz with a suggested level from A1 to C1.
placement.title: Find your level
placement.lead: Ten sentences, getting harder. Pick the word that fits — guessing is fine, stopping is too.
placement.skip: I don’t know any more — show my result
placement.talk: Prefer to talk? <contact>Come by the office</contact> for a free 15-minute chat.
placement.note: A quiz is only a start — on your first day we talk for fifteen minutes and move you if another class fits better.

school.description: The teachers, the building, discounts and answers to common questions.
school.title: The school
school.teachersTitle: Six of us, all of whom moved once

contact.description: Write to {{name}} or come by the office in {{city}}.
contact.title: Say hallo
contact.lead: Write to us in English, German or anything in between. We answer within a working day and are happy to call you back.
contact.caption: Can’t come in? Every level is also taught online, in the evening.

notFound.title: Diese Seite gibt es nicht.
notFound.text: That’s German for “this page doesn’t exist”. You’ve already learnt something. <home>Back to the start</home>.
